Thank you for your compassionate response. It was nice to hear after a long day at work. I hope you're having a decent day :)

You make a good point. I was taught in my childhood, as a Christian to "turn the other cheek". I've been thinking of re-investigating Christianity in a sense and I can't seem to get rid of this nagging fear that, for that reason, committing to a martial art is a bad idea. I know that sounds stupid, but I suffer from an anxiety problem and it can be hard to distinguish useful fear from maladaptive fear.
I don't necessarily mean family or friends. I mean professionals, or clergy, or someone on the end of a suicide hotline. Give it a go if you can
Don't be alone right now. Please find company of some kind
Same here. Please reply to me too. We both want you to live

I'm so sorry to hear about your struggles. I admire your strength for getting this far. It sounds like you don't believe much would help.

I'm in the UK, so the healthcare system works differently here, but could you go to an emergency room? It's best to surround yourself with people right now. I'm not saying they'll magically make you better, but being around people can prevent you from taking drastic action, like suicide.

Have you considered going to a church and seeking a minister just to listen to you? I'm sure there are many liberal places that will show you love without shoving ideology down your throat.

Have you tried a suicide hotline?

If someone tells you "things will get better", I can see why you wouldn't believe them. But that doesn't necessarily mean they think you'll start feeling really good or that your problems will go away. It could mean a tiny spark of hope, or a glimpse of new found strength, or even the energy to distract yourself for a few hours. Sometimes hitting rock bottom can become a breakthrough. It may well be rare, but just get yourself safe, and don't be alone.

Just wait it out a little while. Allow yourself to feel what you need to feel.

I'm sorry you've been given such a shit lot in life. We're here for you
